details: For every nonempty finite class, the stronger bound $\mathrm Q_{\mathrm{eq}}(\mathcal H)\leq|\mathcal H|-1$ holds.
proof: The proper strategy is also admissible when arbitrary equivalence hypotheses are allowed: propose a remaining concept and every negative answer eliminates it. Thus at most $|\mathcal H|-1$ equivalence queries are needed.
name: Size / Equivalence Queries Complexity
